name: Desperate Prayer
summary: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena teaches human acolytes a prayer for when their lives are in danger. It calls on the Holy Light to heal a priest's wounds when all else fails.

sections.title: A Plea in the Dark
sections.body: Priests of the Cathedral of Light use their faith to shield companions, heal wounds, and strike at evil. Even the devout may be isolated, cornered, or close to death. In that moment, an acolyte can call to the Holy Light for help, with their own life at stake.

sections.title: The Cathedral's Blessing
sections.body: High Priestess Laurena guides the clergy in Stormwind's Cathedral Square and decides when an acolyte is ready for deeper teachings. Human initiates who show devotion to the Light across the kingdom receive this lesson as protection and as a charge to keep serving the realm.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer calls on the Holy Light to heal a wounded priest's critical injuries at once, without a long chant.

faq.q: Who grants this lesson in Stormwind?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena grants this lesson in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. She teaches acolytes who have shown devotion and experience in the wider world.

faq.q: Why do priests receive this specific teaching?
aliases: why do priests get desperate prayer
faq.answer: Priests of the Holy Light risk their lives to aid others. This prayer can preserve a healer's life when they are alone or badly hurt.

faq.q: Can any adventurer learn Desperate Prayer here?
faq.answer: No. Only priests devoted to the Holy Light and guided by the Church of the Light receive this lesson.

faq.q: Where does this rite take place?
faq.answer: The rite takes place in the Cathedral of Light, in the northern district of Stormwind City.

faq.q: Is Desperate Prayer unique to human priests?
aliases: do other races get desperate prayer
faq.answer: Both human and dwarven clergy in Alliance lands can learn Desperate Prayer. Their traditions of worshiping the Holy Light are closely allied in Stormwind and Ironforge.

angles.text: As a priest, you pass from apprentice acolyte to active servant of the Holy Light, ready to survive deadly trials in the field.
As a human, you receive this teaching from the Cathedral of Light's clergy. It affirms Stormwind's place as the foremost seat of human faith.
As a member of the Alliance, you know blessings like Desperate Prayer help keep frontline healers alive to tend soldiers on dangerous frontiers.
